source: Gobierno de Aragon, Instituto Geografico de Aragon (IGEAR), Arboles Singulares de Aragon
licence_proof: Verbatim from the IGEAR GeoNetwork record: 'Creative Commons Attribution (cc-by) Esta obra esta bajo una licencia de Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 Internacional'. And the Instituto Geografico de Aragon blanket statement: 'Todos los conjuntos de datos que ofrece el Instituto Geografico de Aragon, si no se indica lo contrario, se publican bajo los terminos de la licencia Creative Commons Reconocimiento CC-BY 4.0.'
designation: Arbol Singular de Aragon (Natural Monument, declared by BOA decree)
attribution: Instituto Geografico de Aragon (IGEAR), Gobierno de Aragon
scope: 45 individually declared singular trees across the whole autonomous community. Fields are INSPIRE protected-site boilerplate: objectid, sitecode, sitename, legalfoundationdate, legalfoundationdocument (link to the BOA decree), sitedesignation, designationscheme, latitude, longitude, utmx, utmy, observations, esactivo.
caveat: NO age field, NO species field and NO girth or height. Species is only inferable from the vernacular sitename ("Tejo de la Espata", "Sabina de Villamayor"), and observations is null on all 45 rows. ZERO entries fall inside the municipality of Zaragoza: this is a rural conservation instrument and it does not cover urban trees, which is why it could not be used as a second source for the Zaragoza city pass. The nearest entry to the city is the Sabina de Villamayor at 15 km, a lone tree with no cluster around it. Discovery note: the dataset is NOT on opendata.aragon.es, whose CKAN API lives at /api/3/action/ and holds no tree datasets; it lives in the IGEAR GeoServer, whose typeNames are undocumented in the GeoNetwork metadata and only appear in GetCapabilities.
